trap.label: sem -s no subjuntivo
trap.wrong: The doctor recommends that he takes a rest.
trap.right: The doctor recommends that he take a rest.
trap.why: O brasileiro conjuga o verbo normalmente. Depois de recommend that, usa-se a forma base, mesmo com he/she.

opts: I recommend that he not drive.
I recommend that he doesn't to drive.
I recommend that he not to drive.

mcq.q: Qual frase é uma possibilidade perdida (não crítica)?
mcq.why: could have + particípio = possibilidade que não se realizou.

opts: She doesn't has to work today.
She doesn't have to work today.
She don't have to work today.

fix.wrong: The teacher recommended that we to read it.
fix.right: The teacher recommended that we read it.

fix.wrong: The belief what money matters is common.
fix.right: The belief that money matters is common.

fix.why: A estrutura é should have + particípio, não should had.
